name: Date Masamune
source:
Hobby: Cooking
Special Skill: Incense Ceremony Master
Charm Point: A cook of the turbulent times

A warrior who loves a good thrill as much as a good battle. He strongly believes that it's his duty to live a life worthy of the title of military commander. A free spirit, his natural curiosity causes him to be drawn to you from the start.

"Life's an adventure with you. You'll keep me on my toes, right?"

[from the app]
